Goal: Extract app positioning before writing store copy
Prompt Template: I will provide an app idea, feature list, or codebase summary. Act as an ASO specialist and identify the USP, primary persona, core problem, keyword clusters, best-fit category, and tags.
Output Schema: { usp, persona, short_tail_keywords, long_tail_keywords, category, tags, differentiation }
Required Inputs: feature summary, target user, monetization model, platform scope
Length/Limit: No invented claims; infer only from provided facts
Quality Gate: Use plain language and avoid keyword stuffing
Notes: Start with facts, then infer positioning

Prompt Template: Generate an app name that combines the brand with one core keyword. Keep it readable and policy-safe.
Notes: Prefer natural phrasing over forced keyword matches

Prompt Template: Write a short description that states the main value and ends with a soft CTA.
Quality Gate: One sentence only; no spammy repetition

Prompt Template: Write a full description with sections for intro, key features, benefits, how it works, trust, and privacy.
Output Schema: { intro, features, benefits, how_it_works, trust, privacy }
Quality Gate: Must be truthful, readable, and scannable
Notes: Use bullet lists and short paragraphs

Prompt Template: List short-tail and long-tail keywords with priority levels and intent notes.
Required Inputs: industry, user pain points, competitor context
Length/Limit: No volume claims unless provided by data

Prompt Template: Map the app features to the likely content rating answers and flag any uncertain items that need human confirmation.
Output Schema: { violence, language, user_control, location, social_features, gambling }
Required Inputs: app interactions, social features, location use, user-generated content
Length/Limit: Do not guess when the feature is unknown

Prompt Template: List the data types the app actually collects or shares, how they are used, and whether they are encrypted in transit and deletable.
Output Schema: { personal_info, location, device_id, app_activity, photos_videos, files_docs, encryption, deletion_request }
Required Inputs: actual data collection flows, analytics, auth, ads, location usage
Length/Limit: Only declare data that exists in the product
Notes: Match the declaration to real behavior

Prompt Template: Generate a privacy policy outline covering collection, use, sharing, retention, security, and user requests.
Output Schema: { overview, data_collected, purpose, sharing, retention, security, user_rights, contact }
Required Inputs: support email, domain, data handling model
Length/Limit: Must be published at a stable URL
Quality Gate: Include deletion request path when supported
Notes: Keep the language clear and direct

Prompt Template: Create a screenshot plan that shows the core value first, then the main workflows, trust signals, and final CTA.
Required Inputs: top feature, target persona, core workflow
Quality Gate: First image must show the core feature

Prompt Template: Define the feature graphic message, visual focus, and safe area for the Play Store feature graphic.
Required Inputs: one core promise, brand colors, icon, logo
Quality Gate: No tiny text; keep the message bold

Prompt Template: Localize the store listing and keyword set for each target language without changing the product promise.
Create a final checklist for policy, privacy, screenshots, contact info, and store consistency.
Output Schema: { policy, privacy, contact, screenshots, data_safety, rating, metadata }
Quality Gate: No missing links or broken contact paths
Notes: Treat this as the final gate before submission

Prompt Template: Return the final Google Play workflow result in both Markdown and JSON so it can be pasted into Play Console tooling or a docs pipeline.
